text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Why, if it isn't my dear Shakur! I hear<n>it's your
birthday!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: But I haven't said anything yet?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I already know you've brought along<n>some
dumbass contraption for me to<n>test.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I've told you plenty of times already,<n>but I don't
have any interest in being<n>your guinea pig.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
How regrettable. And after I came all<n>this way to
sincerely wish my friend a<n>happy birthday.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The hell? I know you don't have a<n>single sincere
bone in your body.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hmm... If that is your stance, then so<n>be it.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
But at the very least, understand that<n>I prepared a
wonderful present for<n>you from the bottom of my
pure,<n>sincere heart!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Behold, my latest concoction! I call it,<n>"Scroll Even in
Your Dreams!" One<n>sip, and you'll be able to scroll
on<n>your computer while aslee—
